reason: Fit the left rail to the tray as the goal directs; it is the only offered action.
expectation: The rail should attach along the tray’s left edge.

effect: The left rail is in place, and the next goal is to fit the right rail.
reaction: The visible change is clear, though straightforward.
reason: Fit the right rail as directed; it is the only offered combination.
expectation: The right rail should attach along the opposite side of the board.

effect: Both side rails are fitted; the next goal is the top rail.
reaction: The matching rails make the progress clear.
reason: Fit the top rail as directed; it is the only offered combination.
expectation: The curved rail should attach across the top of the board.

effect: The curved top rail joins the side rails; the next goal is the lane rail.
reaction: The outline of the table is coming together clearly.
reason: Fit the lane rail as directed; it is the only offered combination.
expectation: The thin rail should attach to the board to form a lane, though its exact position is unclear.

effect: The lane rail forms a narrow lane along the right edge; the next goal is the left return.
reaction: Its position makes the lane's shape clearer.
reason: Fit the left return as directed; it is the only offered combination.
expectation: The curved return should attach on the left side, probably near the lower end of the table.

effect: The left return curves the rail inward at the front; the next goal is the right return.
reaction: The change is clear, though the repeated fittings are becoming routine.
reason: Fit the right return as directed; it is the only offered combination.
expectation: The right return should attach near the front on the opposite side, though its exact shape may differ.

effect: Both returns are fitted, leaving a gap at the front; the next goal is the marble cup.
reaction: The gap makes the arrangement clear, though the rail fittings felt repetitive.
reason: Fit the marble cup as directed; it is the only offered combination.
expectation: The cup should attach near the front gap to catch the marble, though its exact position is uncertain.

effect: The marble cup fills the front gap, and the chapter is complete, though the table does not yet match the full build reference.
reaction: The cup’s placement is clear, but completion feels a little abrupt.

mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the lane rail was most worthwhile: its position showed how a distinct lane takes shape.

leastWorthwhile.text: The successive left and right return fittings were clear but repetitive, with only one combination offered each time.

surprise.text: I was surprised the chapter ended after the marble cup, before the arches, paddles and other parts shown in the build reference appeared.

arbitrary.text: No fitting felt purposeless, although the instructions prescribed every choice rather than letting me work out the order.

continue.text: I would probably continue to see whether the remaining pinball components are added, though I would hope for more varied decisions.
